about.name: Sharif Rayhan
about.title: Software Engineer
about.tagline: Full-stack developer building scalable web applications with Spring Boot, FastAPI, React, and Next.js.
summary: I’m a software engineer at Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi) in Dhaka, where I build backend services with Java and Spring Boot for a US-based client.

I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from the University of Dhaka. I enjoy designing clean REST APIs, getting authentication right with JWT and OAuth 2.0, automating repetitive work with Bash, and shipping services with Docker, Linux, and CI/CD.
Beyond day-to-day engineering, I’ve published research on long-video question answering, served as President of the CSEDU Students’ Club, and still enjoy competitive programming.

highlights: Contribute to backend development with Java and Spring Boot on a project for a US-based client.
Automated the generation of digital transaction statements for US customers using Bash scripting.

education.degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering

projects.title: ToToCompany — Travel & Flight Booking Platform
projects.description: A full-stack travel web application for exploring global landmarks, browsing flight information, and managing user profiles with secure authentication.
highlights: Developed REST APIs using Spring Boot and MySQL for backend services and user management.
Implemented landmark exploration with search and filtering, along with a flight search interface.
Integrated Google OAuth 2.0 authentication, JWT-based security, email OTP verification, and password recovery.
Applied Singleton, Factory, MVC, and Builder design patterns to improve code organization and maintainability.

projects.title: CSEDU Department Website
projects.description: A collaborative project building the official website of the University of Dhaka’s CSE department, covering user management, academic resources, announcements, and event scheduling.
highlights: Designed and implemented REST APIs for the meetings, events, and announcements modules.
Developed the meetings, events, and announcements pages and integrated them with the backend APIs.

projects.title: Marketplace Web Application
projects.description: Flask-based backend system with REST APIs designed using a modular and scalable architecture for efficient data handling.
highlights: Designed and implemented RESTful APIs in Flask for core marketplace functionality.
Structured the backend with a modular architecture for scalability and maintainability.
Handled data processing and routing for client-server communication.

projects.title: NetConnect — Terminal-Based Group Chat System
projects.description: Multi-user real-time chat application with group creation, member approval, and access control using a custom networking protocol.
highlights: Implemented real-time multi-user messaging using socket programming.
Designed group creation and approval-based access control mechanisms.
Developed a custom communication protocol for efficient and reliable data exchange.

research.title: CATS: Curvature-Adaptive Temporal Suppression for Long-Video Question Answering
research.description: A novel budget-aware frame selection method for multimodal large language models addressing inefficiencies in long-video question answering caused by suboptimal frame sampling.
highlights: Introduces curvature-adaptive temporal suppression to reduce redundant frames.
Preserves short-term salient events and long-range contextual information.
Improves efficiency for multimodal LLM-based long-video QA systems.

leadership.description: Led the students’ club of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Dhaka (CSEDU).
highlights: Organized a 40-team Capture the Flag (CTF) cybersecurity competition for University of Dhaka students.
Organized the VisionX AI Hackathon, a joint event of CSEDU, US-Bangla, and the ICT Division, with 50 teams from universities across Bangladesh.
Organized Code Samurai, a two-day national hackathon with 50 teams from across the country, held jointly by CSEDU, BJIT, and Japan-based IT and business companies.
